channel.title: The Golf Channel - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: PGA Tour rookie records first hole-in-one in TGL history
item.description: The ace came off the club of Neal Shipley, the PGA Tour rookie who was debuting for The Bay Golf Club on Monday night at SoFi Center.

item.title: Lucas Glover has a voice on the radio. Now he wants it heard in the PGA Tour boardroom
item.description: Glover always had a strong voice. He's at a point now where the former U.S. Open champion would rather it be heard in the PGA Tour boardroom instead of on the radio.

item.title: McIlroy starts Tour season at Pebble; what drives him in '26?
item.description: Rory McIlroy was on the practice range Tuesday at Pebble Beach, ready to begin his PGA Tour season. Rex Hoggard and Eamon Lynch discuss what will motivate the defending AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am champion in 2026.

item.title: Is Gotterup a star? Maltbie will judge with eyes and ears
item.description: Roger Maltbie will be roaming the grounds again at select events in 2026. When asked if he thought Chris Gotterup was destined for stardom, the veteran said, he'll be the judge when he sees (and hears) him up close.

item.title: Fleetwood ready to regain 'rhythm' in 2026 PGA Tour debut
item.description: Tommy Fleetwood finished 2025 on a tear but after a few sleepy events on the DPWT, he's making his 2026 PGA Tour debut at Pebble Beach and looking to regain that world-class form.

item.title: Charlie Woods verbally commits to ACC powerhouse
item.description: The 16-year-old Woods, son of Tiger Woods, has verbally committed to Florida State University, it was announced on Tuesday.

item.title: The Players a major? Here's what Rory McIlroy thinks
item.description: If anyone should get a say in whether The Players should be anointed as golf’s fifth major championship, it’s a guy who’s won each of the four actual majors, plus the PGA Tour’s flagship event at TPC Sawgrass.

item.title: This Rory McIlroy experiment is officially over
item.description: Remember when McIlroy switched to cavity-back irons? Well, he’s switched back to blades.

item.title: Rose seeks more 'moments,' beginning this week at Pebble Beach
item.description: After his dominating win at Torrey Pines and trip home to celebrate, Justin Rose returns to competition at this week's signature AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am, where he prevailed in 2023.

item.title: Justin Rose opts for pitch-and-putt day at Pebble Beach
item.description: Rose picked a good day for an abbreviated practice. As the Monterey Peninsula turned nasty late Tuesday morning, flipping from ideal conditions to chilly, 30 mph winds seemingly in a flash, Rose was close to wrapping.
